name: tiao-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper for the Tiao Android + iOS apps.

scripts.cap:run:ios: pnpm run cap:sync && cap run ios
scripts.cap:run:android: bash -c 'source scripts/android-env.sh && pnpm run build:client && cap sync android && cap run android'
scripts.build:android:release:
bash -c 'source scripts/android-env.sh && pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && echo "
✅ AAB: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab"'
scripts.build:android:apk:
bash -c 'source scripts/android-env.sh && pnpm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && echo "
✅ APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"'
scripts.build:ios:release: bash -c 'echo "⚠️  iOS release builds need an Apple Developer account, Team ID configured in Xcode, and a distribution certificate + provisioning profile. See mobile/README.md."; pnpm run cap:sync && cap open ios'
scripts.android:logcat: bash -c 'source scripts/android-env.sh && adb logcat -s Capacitor Capacitor/Console Capacitor/WebView chromium'
